#!/bin/bash

# variables
APPDIR="/Applications/"
LOGGED_IN_USER=$(scutil <<< "show State:/Users/ConsoleUser" | awk '/Name :/ { print $3 }')
# functions

quit_application() {
  local bundle_id="$1"
  local timeout_duration=10

  # check if the application is running
  local app_running
  app_running=$(osascript -e "application id \"$bundle_id\" is running" 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ "$app_running" != "true" ]]; then
    return
  fi

  local console_user
  console_user=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console)
  if [[ -z "$console_user" || "$console_user" == "root" || "$console_user" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
    echo "Not logged into a non-root GUI; skipping quitting application ID '$bundle_id'."
    return
  fi

  echo "Quitting application '$bundle_id'..."

  # try to quit the application within the timeout period
  local quit_success=false still_running
  SECONDS=0
  while (( SECONDS < timeout_duration )); do
    osascript -e "tell application id \"$bundle_id\" to quit" >/dev/null 2>&1
    sleep 1
    if still_running=$(osascript -e "application id \"$bundle_id\" is running" 2>/dev/null) && [[ "$still_running" == "false" ]]; then
      echo "Application '$bundle_id' quit successfully."
      quit_success=true
      break
    fi
  done

  if [[ "$quit_success" = false ]]; then
    echo "Application '$bundle_id' did not quit."
    return 1
  fi
}


remove_system_path() {
  local target="$1"
  local parent name rel top expected
  parent="$(dirname "$target")"
  name="$(basename "$target")"
  rel="${parent#/}"
  top="/${rel%%/*}"
  expected="$(cd -P "$top" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)${parent#"$top"}"

  (
    cd -P "$parent" 2>/dev/null || exit 1
    if [[ "$(pwd -P)" != "$expected" ]]; then
      echo "Skipped $target: a folder in its path is a symlink."
      exit 0
    fi
    rm -rf "./$name"
  ) || echo "Failed to remove $target."
}

trash() {
  local logged_in_user="$1"
  local target_file="$2"
  local timestamp="$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%s)"
  local rand="$(jot -r 1 0 99999)"
  local trash=""

  # Paths in the user's home are moved to their Trash as the user: the user
  # controls those paths and ~/.Trash, so as root the move could be redirected
  # into a root-only directory. Other paths are deleted as root by
  # remove_system_path. At the login window there's no user Trash, so home
  # paths are skipped. Removal is best-effort and never fails the uninstall.
  if [[ "$target_file" == ~* ]]; then
    if [[ -z "$logged_in_user" || "$logged_in_user" == "root" || "$logged_in_user" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
      echo "Not logged into a non-root GUI; skipping $target_file."
      return
    fi
    # replace ~ with /Users/$logged_in_user
    target_file="/Users/$logged_in_user${target_file:1}"
    trash="/Users/$logged_in_user/.Trash"
  fi

  # If the target contains glob characters, expand it and remove each match.
  if [[ "$target_file" == *[*?[]* ]]; then
    local file file_name
    local matched=false
    local i=0
    # compgen -G expands the (quoted) pattern itself, so paths containing
    # spaces glob correctly; reading line by line keeps each match intact.
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      [[ -n "$file" ]] || continue
      [[ -e "$file" || -L "$file" ]] || continue
      matched=true
      i=$((i + 1))
      file_name="$(basename "$file")"
      echo "removing $file."
      if [[ -z "$trash" ]]; then
        remove_system_path "$file"
      else
        # The per-match counter keeps matches that share a basename from
        # overwriting each other in the trash.
        sudo -u "$logged_in_user" mv -f "$file" "$trash/${file_name}_${timestamp}_${rand}_${i}" || echo "Failed to move $file to the Trash."
      fi
    done < <(compgen -G "$target_file" 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ "$matched" == false ]]; then
      echo "$target_file doesn't exist."
    fi
    return
  fi

  local file_name="$(basename "${target_file}")"

  if [[ -e "$target_file" ]]; then
    echo "removing $target_file."
    if [[ -z "$trash" ]]; then
      remove_system_path "$target_file"
    else
      sudo -u "$logged_in_user" mv -f "$target_file" "$trash/${file_name}_${timestamp}_${rand}" || echo "Failed to move $target_file to the Trash."
    fi
  else
    echo "$target_file doesn't exist."
  fi
}

quit_application 'com.goodsnooze.vivid' || exit 1
sudo rm -rf "$APPDIR/Vivid.app"
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/Application Support/bugsnag-shared-com.goodsnooze.vivid'
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/Application Support/Vivid'
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/Caches/bugsnag-shared-com.goodsnooze.vivid'
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/Caches/com.goodsnooze.vivid'
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/HTTPStorages/com.goodsnooze.vivid'
trash "$LOGGED_IN_USER" '~/Library/Preferences/com.goodsnooze.vivid.plist'

#!/bin/bash

# variables
APPDIR="/Applications/"
TMPDIR=$(dirname "$(realpath "$INSTALLER_PATH")")
# functions

quit_and_track_application() {
  local bundle_id="$1"
  local var_name="APP_WAS_RUNNING_${bundle_id//[^[:alnum:]_]/_}"
  local timeout_duration=10

  # check if the application is running
  local app_running
  app_running=$(osascript -e "application id \"$bundle_id\" is running" 2>/dev/null)
  if [[ "$app_running" != "true" ]]; then
    eval "export $var_name=0"
    return
  fi

  local console_user
  console_user=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console)
  if [[ -z "$console_user" || "$console_user" == "root" || "$console_user" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
    echo "Not logged into a non-root GUI; skipping quitting application ID '$bundle_id'."
    eval "export $var_name=0"
    return
  fi

  # App was running, mark it for relaunch
  eval "export $var_name=1"
  echo "Application '$bundle_id' was running; will relaunch after installation."

  echo "Quitting application '$bundle_id'..."

  # try to quit the application within the timeout period
  local quit_success=false still_running
  SECONDS=0
  while (( SECONDS < timeout_duration )); do
    osascript -e "tell application id \"$bundle_id\" to quit" >/dev/null 2>&1
    sleep 1
    if still_running=$(osascript -e "application id \"$bundle_id\" is running" 2>/dev/null) && [[ "$still_running" == "false" ]]; then
      echo "Application '$bundle_id' quit successfully."
      quit_success=true
      break
    fi
  done

  if [[ "$quit_success" = false ]]; then
    echo "Application '$bundle_id' did not quit."
    return 1
  fi
}


relaunch_application() {
  local bundle_id="$1"
  local var_name="APP_WAS_RUNNING_${bundle_id//[^[:alnum:]_]/_}"
  local was_running

  # Check if the app was running before installation
  eval "was_running=\$$var_name"
  if [[ "$was_running" != "1" ]]; then
    return
  fi

  local console_user
  console_user=$(stat -f "%Su" /dev/console)
  if [[ -z "$console_user" || "$console_user" == "root" || "$console_user" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
    echo "Not logged into a non-root GUI; skipping relaunching application ID '$bundle_id'."
    return
  fi

  echo "Relaunching application '$bundle_id'..."

  # Launch the app in the logged-in user's GUI session. Apps launched by root
  # won't register with the user's Dock/GUI, so run 'open' as the console user.
  # Use 'launchctl asuser' to bootstrap into the console user's Mach namespace
  # and GUI session — 'sudo -u' alone doesn't do this, which can cause
  # LSOpenURLsWithRole() failures even when 'open' exits 0.
  local open_status=0
  if [[ $EUID -eq 0 ]]; then
    local console_uid
    console_uid=$(id -u "$console_user")
    /bin/launchctl asuser "$console_uid" sudo -u "$console_user" open -b "$bundle_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || open_status=$?
  else
    open -b "$bundle_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || open_status=$?
  fi

  if [[ $open_status -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "Application '$bundle_id' relaunched successfully."
  else
    echo "Failed to relaunch application '$bundle_id'."
  fi
}


# extract contents
unzip "$INSTALLER_PATH" -d "$TMPDIR"
# copy to the applications folder
quit_and_track_application 'com.goodsnooze.vivid' || exit 1
if [ -d "$APPDIR/Vivid.app" ]; then
	sudo mv "$APPDIR/Vivid.app" "$TMPDIR/Vivid.app.bkp" || exit $?
fi
if ! sudo cp -R "$TMPDIR/Vivid.app" "$APPDIR"; then
	# remove the partial copy so a failed install isn't inventoried as the new
	# version, then restore the previous version if there was one
	sudo rm -rf "$APPDIR/Vivid.app"
	if [ -d "$TMPDIR/Vivid.app.bkp" ]; then
		sudo mv "$TMPDIR/Vivid.app.bkp" "$APPDIR/Vivid.app"
	fi
	exit 1
fi
relaunch_application 'com.goodsnooze.vivid'
